We propose a new version based instead on M ⁡ ( H ) = H cop ▶ ⊲ H M(H)=H^{\text{cop}}{\blacktriangleright\!\!\!

arxiv-2111-04878.title: Automated generation of 0D and 1D reduced-order models of patient-specific blood flow Publication type: Article Type
arxiv-2111-04878.creator: Martin R. Pfaller*, Jonathan Pham, Aekaansh Verma, Luca Pegolotti, Nathan M. Wilson, David W. Parker, Weiguang Yang, Alison L. Marsden
arxiv-2111-04878.description: Abstract Three-dimensional (3D) cardiovascular fluid dynamics simulations typically require hours to days of computing time on a high-performance computing cluster. One-dimensional (1D) and lumped-parameter zero-dimensional (0D) models show great promise for accurately predicting blood bulk flow and pressure waveforms with only a fraction of the cost. They can also accelerate uncertainty quantification, optimization, and design parameterization studies.

arxiv-2112-01737.title: Neutral bremsstrahlung electroluminescence in noble liquids
arxiv-2112-01737.creator: E. Borisova, A. Buzulutskov
arxiv-2112-01737.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by E. Borisova, A. Buzulutskov. Proportional electroluminescence (EL) is the physical effect used in two-phase dark matter detectors, to optically record in the gas phase the ionization signal produced by particle scattering in the liquid phase. In our previous works the presence of a new EL mechanism in noble gases, namely that of neutral bremsstrahlung (NBrS), was demonstrated both theoretically and experimentally, in addition to the ordinary EL mechanism due to excimer emission.

arxiv-2205-08052.title: An Inverse Probability Weighted Regression Method that Accounts for Right-censoring for Causal Inference with Multiple Treatments and a Binary Outcome. Publication type: Article Type
arxiv-2205-08052.creator: Youfei Yu, Min Zhang*, Bhramar Mukherjee
arxiv-2205-08052.description: Abstract Comparative effectiveness research often involves evaluating the differences in the risks of an event of interest between two or more treatments using observational data. Often, the post-treatment outcome of interest is whether the event happens within a pre-specified time window, which leads to a binary outcome.

arxiv-2412-07217.title: Incremental Gaussian Mixture Clustering for Data Streams
arxiv-2412-07217.creator: Aniket Bhanderi, Raj Bhatnagar
arxiv-2412-07217.description: Abstract The problem of analyzing data streams of very large volumes is important and is very desirable for many application domains. In this paper we present and demonstrate effective working of an algorithm to find clusters and anomalous data points in a streaming datasets.

arxiv-2502-21022.title: When Unsupervised Domain Adaptation meets One-class Anomaly Detection: Addressing the Two-fold Unsupervised Curse by Leveraging Anomaly Scarcity
arxiv-2502-21022.creator: Nesryne Mejri, Enjie Ghorbel, Anis Kacem, Pavel Chernakov, Niki Foteinopoulou, Djamila Aouada
arxiv-2502-21022.description: Abstract This paper introduces the first fully unsupervised domain adaptation (UDA) framework for unsupervised anomaly detection (UAD). The performance of UAD techniques degrades significantly in the presence of a domain shift, difficult to avoid in a real-world setting. While UDA has contributed to solving this issue in binary and multi-class classification, such a strategy is ill-posed in UAD.

arxiv-2504-15320.title: Efficient and Safe Planner for Automated Driving on Ramps Considering Unsatisfication Thanks: † Common contribution Thanks: § Corresponding author
arxiv-2504-15320.creator: 1 st Qinghao Li †, 2 nd Zhen Tian †, 3 th Xiaodan Wang, 4 th Jinming Yang, 5 th Zhihao Lin §
arxiv-2504-15320.description: Abstract Automated driving on ramps presents significant challenges due to the need to balance both safety and efficiency during lane changes. This paper proposes an integrated planner for automated vehicles (AVs) on ramps, utilizing an unsatisfactory level metric for efficiency and arrow-cluster-based sampling for safety.

arxiv-2509-22059.title: Stable and Interpretable Jet Physics with IRC-Safe Equivariant Feature Extraction
arxiv-2509-22059.creator: Partha Konar, Vishal S. Ngairangbam, Michael Spannowsky, and Deepanshu Srivastava
arxiv-2509-22059.description: Abstract Deep learning has achieved remarkable success in jet classification tasks, yet a key challenge remains: understanding what these models learn and how their features relate to known QCD observables. Improving interpretability is essential for building robust and trustworthy machine learning tools in collider physics.

arxiv-2510-00185.title: Object-Centric Case-Based Reasoning via Argumentation
arxiv-2510-00185.creator: Gabriel de Olim Gaul, Adam Gould, Avinash Kori, Francesca Toni
arxiv-2510-00185.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Gabriel de Olim Gaul, Adam Gould, Avinash Kori, Francesca Toni. We introduce Slot Attention Argumentation for Case-Based Reasoning (SAA-CBR), a novel neuro-symbolic pipeline for image classification that integrates object-centric learning via a neural Slot Attention (SA) component with symbolic reasoning conducted by Abstract Argumentation for Case-Based Reasoning (AA-CBR).

pmc-10537911.title: Fuzzy optimization for identifying antiviral targets for treating SARS-CoV-2 infection in the heart
pmc-10537911.creator: Sz-Wei Chu, Feng-Sheng Wang
pmc-10537911.description: In this paper, a fuzzy hierarchical optimization framework is proposed for identifying potential antiviral targets for treating severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2) infection in the heart. The proposed framework comprises four objectives for evaluating the elimination of viral biomass growth and the minimization of side effects during treatment.

pmc-12494027.title: Observation of anomalous thermal Hall effect in a Kagome superconductor
pmc-12494027.creator: Hiroki Yoshida, Hikaru Takeda, Jian Yan, Yui Kanemori, Brenden R. Ortiz, Yuzki M. Oey, Stephen D. Wilson, Marcin Konczykowski, Kota Ishihara, Takasada Shibauchi, Minoru Yamashita
pmc-12494027.description: Broken time-reversal symmetry (TRS) in superconductors can induce not only spontaneous magnetization by the finite angular momentum of Cooper pairs but also the anomalous thermal Hall effects (ATHEs), whose detection has been extremely challenging. Here, we report the successful observation of an ATHE developing below the superconducting transition temperature at zero magnetic field in the kagome-lattice superconductor CsV3Sb5.

pmc-12976741.title: Case Report: long-term survival of a male patient with breast cancer complicated by lung adenocarcinoma treated with individualized therapy
pmc-12976741.creator: Yadong Liu, Xuejuan Duan, Zhenru Zheng, Gang Cheng, Xianbo Zhang, Jing Zhao
pmc-12976741.description: Male breast cancer (MBC) is a rare malignant tumor with unique clinical characteristics, accounting for only approximately 1% of all breast cancer cases. Although its pathological features are similar to those of female breast cancer (FBC), significant differences exist in the clinical manifestations, diagnosis, and prognosis of MBC.

pmc-13093823.title: Preventing Cognitive Frailty: What People Know and What They Are Willing to Change
pmc-13093823.creator: Shaimaa Mohammed Elhag, Tasmin Alanna Rookes, Malwina Agnieszka Niechcial, Mohaddeseh Ziyachi, Ruoyu Wang, Millennium Soibifaa Iyobuchiebomie, Alan John Gow
pmc-13093823.description: PurposeCognitive frailty (CF), defined as the co‐existence of physical frailty and cognitive impairment in the absence of dementia, may be preventable. Interventions could target modifiable risk factors that promote healthy aging. However, awareness of public knowledge of CF and willingness to engage in preventative behaviors, particularly across demographic groups, remains limited.

pmc-13278934.title: Monomorphic epitheliotropic intestinal T-cell lymphoma presenting as acute small intestinal perforation: a case report and exploratory BCL-2–targeted therapy
pmc-13278934.creator: Meijuan He, Yao Zhou, Jia Yao, Qiu Zhang, Wenjing Xu, Xiaoping Ye, Yihan Cai, Zefa Liu
pmc-13278934.description: ObjectiveTo report a rare case of monomorphic epitheliotropic intestinal T-cell lymphoma (MEITL) presenting with acute gastrointestinal perforation and to describe the use of an exploratory regimen combining a BCL-2 inhibitor (Venetoclax) with CHOP chemotherapy, highlighting the diagnostic challenges and therapeutic considerations for this aggressive disease.MethodsWe detail the clinicopathological journey of a 72-year-old male patient who presented with an acute abdomen.

pmc-13621958.title: Current standards and novel concepts in thrombotic thrombocytopenic purpura
pmc-13621958.creator: Johannes Bloehdorn, Mark S. Cragg, Martin Bommer
pmc-13621958.description: Thrombotic thrombocytopenic purpura (TTP) is a rare and rapidly life-threatening thrombotic microangiopathy. Disseminated microvascular thrombosis and resulting ischemia are the critical events determining outcome, if left untreated. The pathogenic hallmark is a severe deficiency of the plasma metalloprotease ADAMTS13, resulting in impaired cleavage of ultra-large von Willebrand factor (vWF) multimers leading to platelet aggregation.
